fields.name: Govinda Ghoṣa
fields.aka: Govinda Ghosh, Govinda Gosh, Ghoṣa Ṭhākura, Govindānanda (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 8.16, probably)
fields.place: Agradvīpa (his Śrīpāṭa, Śrī Gopīnātha; the Viśvakoṣa: Kāśīpura Viṣṇutalā near Agradvīpa); earlier Kumārahaṭṭa and Navadvīpa
fields.notes:
An uttara-rāḍhīya Kāyastha, brother of Vāsudeva and Mādhava Ghoṣa; with them a branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.115); he stayed with the Lord when his brothers went with Nityānanda to Bengal (Ādi 10.117-118); lead singer of a kīrtana party at the Ratha-yātrā (Madhya 13). Installed Śrī Gopīnātha at Agradvīpa, who performs his śrāddha every year.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kalāvatī, who sang Viśākhā's songs (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 188).
Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”.

fields.name: Mādhava Ghoṣa
fields.place: Kumārahaṭṭa, then Navadvīpa; Śrīpāṭa said to be at Dāiṅhāṭ (no trace of him there: Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna)
fields.notes:
Brother of Vāsudeva and Govinda Ghoṣa; a branch of Lord Caitanya (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.115), later counted also in Nityānanda's branch, «a principal kīrtana singer: Nityānanda danced to his singing» (Ādi 11.18); went with Nityānanda to Bengal (Ādi 10.117-118); sang the dāna-līlā at Gadādhara dāsa's temple.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Rasollāsā, who sang Viśākhā's songs (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 188).

fields.name: Devānanda Paṇḍita
fields.notes:
A famous teacher of the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam at Kuliyā; his students threw Śrīvāsa out of his class and Mahāprabhu rebuked him (Caitanya-bhāgavata Madhya 9, 21); by serving Vakreśvara Paṇḍita he received the Lord's mercy and the devotional meaning of the Bhāgavatam (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.77; Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 3).

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Bhāguri Muni (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 104).

Dates/place from B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”. Not Devānanda the Vaidya of Nityānanda's line (#204).
